scripts.build: node scripts/patch-start.mjs && node scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs vite build
scripts.start: node scripts/patch-start.mjs && node scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs vite preview --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.preview: node scripts/patch-start.mjs && node scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs vite preview --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:api
scripts.test:db: node scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/db.test.ts
scripts.test:api: node scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/api.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/patch-start.mjs && node scripts/run-with-esbuild.mjs playwright test
